finalMessage:
`Refunder.refund` exists to send money back to the **original payment transaction** while enforcing the refund rules: no more than remains on the charge, and a second approval when an account’s refunds exceed 500.00 in one UTC day. It tracks those totals and appends an audit entry after a successful gateway refund. These purposes are recorded as `R-REFUND-ORIGINAL`, `R-REFUND-LIMIT`, and `R-AUDIT-MONEY` in [trace/requirements.yaml](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.py-shell.ts-shop.T1.3/repo/trace/requirements.yaml) and implemented in [refunds.ts](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.py-shell.ts-shop.T1.3/repo/src/refunds.ts:66).

The direct tests are in [refunds.test.ts](/private/tmp/ostf-trials/runs/codex.py-shell.ts-shop.T1.3/repo/src/refunds.test.ts:48):

- **“refunds to the original transaction”** checks gateway destination, audit entry, and rejection of a refund exceeding the remaining charge.
- **“totals refunds per account and UTC day”** checks the daily approval limit and its reset on the next UTC day.

The `checkRefundLimit` tests in the same file also cover the validation helper that `Refunder.refund` calls.
